description: Rust-native password generation, audit evidence, and encrypted local-vault tooling.
rules: Use the audited paranoid-core path for password generation, entropy, hashing, and statistical audit decisions.
Keep Cargo builds locked, frozen, offline, and resolved through the checked-in vendor tree.
Do not add custom cryptography, ad hoc randomness, modulo sampling, browser secret handling, or handwritten unsafe Rust.
Treat the CLI, TUI, GUI, documentation, and automation layers as adapters; keep security-sensitive logic in the Rust core crates.
